notes: The ONLY source treating a wet underside as DESIRABLE. Directly contradicts Carlsbad and King Arthur, who treat the identical condition as a defect, and Smitten Kitchen, who calls it inevitable. title: Drop-Biscuit Peach-Blueberry Cobbler
flags: NO BUTTER AT ALL; highest hydration in the cobbler corpus; Substack — no rating system.
notes: Names cakey as the deliberate target, and explains why: no butter means no flakiness. Her soda-to-buttermilk of 0.0100 is computed on buttermilk alone; against TOTAL liquid she is at 0.00335, the lowest alkalinity per unit dough in the corpus, because 238 g of heavy cream is essentially non-acidic and does not participate in neutralisation. This is the clearest case where the two denominators disagree.
